facts.what: 前夜失眠，6 a.m. 起床准备「一生一次的约会」
facts.anchor: the clock on my phone finally reached 6 a.m.

facts.what: 凌晨两点半涂了芭比粉趾甲，视为今日省一事
facts.anchor: fresh Barbie-pink toenails I decided to paint at half two in the morning

facts.what: 独自在家怕意外无人知晓：浴室滑倒、止痛药后睡死
facts.anchor: I could slip in the shower and knock myself unconscious.

facts.what: 久未出门，自称蛰居靠送货上门，「就这么发生了」
facts.anchor: I didn’t plan on isolating myself from the outside world. It just sort of happened

facts.what: 洗四遍头、两把剃刀、宣告重生如蛇蜕皮
facts.anchor: Two disposable razors later and I felt like the smoothest of dolphins.

facts.what: 出门前给 Luna 满碗猫粮，怕自己晚归
facts.anchor: just in case tonight goes really well and I don’t make it back until late

facts.what: 开门时右耳尖鸣并吼 RUN；她回「知道了」照样开门

relations: Cassie 为约会出门；与 Luna 同住
